page.overview:
Who is 50% Chad?

50% Chad is a mysterious pair of legs that became a member of the Brotherhood of Nada. Using its ability to weaken its opponents with its stench, it fought the Doom Patrol as the Brotherhood of Nada tried to distort reality.
